title: an-unvouched-green-completes-and-notifies
intention: A green that measurement cannot vouch for (a revert the proofs cannot see, or a green whose measurement conditions moved between its red and its green) completes its crossing and notifies the operator with one line naming the file and showing the diff, and the notification rate is measured from the first one.
why: A green can pass because the change was invisible to the proof, or because the conditions of measurement moved, while the system no longer matches the model in Akien's head. A skip rule covers today's case and misses next week's; a red holds a ticket over a judgement only he can make. Completing and notifying puts the one-line diff in front of the one reader who holds the spec, and git keeps every part reversible.
traces_to: Akien's answer to open-ed0a56ce6357 ("we let it complete AND notify me. because the repo has the whole history anyway, we can back out a part if needed"); Law 9 (the spec is in his head, so a green the instrument cannot vouch for goes to the one reader who holds the spec); Law 3 (the rate is measured, not assumed); Law 7 (the unvouched case is said at a diagnostic surface, never collapsed into a pass or a skip)
how: Four children, one per component boundary (RULE 1), proved before this parent: (1) harbor_master's clearance reads a hollow reading value {"notified": <notice id>} as covered, so the PROVED rung no longer refuses hollow_file for a file the tester has sent to the operator; (2) the tester's hollow turns a file whose revert redded no declared tooth into a notice (one line: file + the diff between the pre-build blob and HEAD) instead of a red reason, seals {"notified": id}, keeps its notices under its own instance address and answers `notices` (unseen list + rate) and `notice-seen` on the bus; (3) the operator inbox gains a lane that asks the tester's `notices` verb and shows each line and the rate; (4) every proof run record carries its measurement conditions (proof bytes, fixture bytes, interpreter, isolation, CAIRN_* environment), a red is sealed before the build, and a green seal whose proof's last red record ran under different conditions posts a notice the same way. Then e0f318650123 completes with its two docstring files and the post_commit charter as notices.
falsifier: GREEN when (a) a ticket whose hollow reads a file hollow crosses PROVED with that file carried as {"notified": id} and exactly one operator notice naming the file with its diff; (b) a green whose proof's last red ran under different conditions crosses and leaves one notice naming the changed condition; (c) the operator inbox shows both with a notices-per-day rate; (d) no skip rule exists (nothing in hollow classifies a file by AST or docstring shape). RED if an unvouched green is refused at PROVED, passes silently, or is skipped by a rule. WRONG INTENT if Akien is inundated (his words: "if i get inundated, we'll change it") — the rate is the instrument that says so. Horizon: e0f318650123 PROVED over its three notices, and the rate reported to the foreground.
watchme: none, because the standing measurement is the tester's own notices rate (child tester-hollow-sends-the-unseen-to-the-operator answers `notices` with a per-day rate, reported to the foreground per ~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md item 6), and Akien's inundation is the wrong-intent signal it already carries
children: tester-hollow-sends-the-unseen-to-the-operator — cairn/devices/tester: a hollow file becomes one notice (file + diff), sealed as {"notified": id}; notices kept under the tester's instance; `notices` and `notice-seen` verbs with the rate.
operator-inbox-shows-the-tester-notices — cairn/tools/operator_inbox: a lane asking the tester's `notices` verb.
a-proof-run-records-its-conditions — cairn/devices/tester: run records carry conditions; a green whose last red ran under other conditions posts a notice.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder at the parent needs only: the children, in order, each PROVED (clearance first so the gate accepts the marker before the tester writes it; then tester hollow notices; then the inbox lane; then run conditions), then the intention written at CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-an-unvouched-green-completes-and-notifies.md quoting the answer verbatim and naming each child's address. Each child carries its own builder notes.
